metadata.title: That 1 kill where I didn’t even look and Valorant said ‘Here, take it and run’
metadata.description:
Wait, did that shot even have a target?
Enemy probably mid existential crisis.
Click if your aim’s a mystery but Valorant still hands out freebies.
Chaos reigns supreme.

Tap if your best kills come from pure accident!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
